_doc: looks_per_day: extra appraisal looks while the cat is home. Not a permanent attribute.
conscience_night: hidden meter gained on the settle night the cat is home. Do not show the number.
mold_permille: rice on the shelf loses this much condition each lost night, only after the cat has lived here.
wander_num/wander_den: after min_nights at home, int(draw * den) < num means the cat leaves.
retry_days: if the find-cat card is not in hand or queued when still lost, queue it again after this many days.
